graft.title: Getting tend in CI from a public repo
graft.need: A documented way for a public repo's CI to get the tend binary: the check action (`uses: vaibhav-gopal/tend/.github/actions/check`) can't be used from a public repo while tend is private, and today tend has no GitHub remote or releases at all, so `Unable to resolve action vaibhav-gopal/tend, repository not found`. A release-download step (gh release download with a token, checksum verified) projects can paste or the baseline can render, or a public distribution of the binary.
graft.use_case: autodyne (public) took its tend check job out of CI until there is one; the baseline's CI workflow for every project (filed with vg-paradigms) needs it too.

answer.text: Documented in tend README (In CI, readme version 9): a public repo cannot use an action from a private one, so it downloads the release with gh release download and a token secret (a fine-grained token that can read tend), checks the .sha256 the release carries, installs it and runs tend check --strict; the step is in the README. Still needed before it works: the first release tag (v0.1.0, which the user publishes) and the REPOS_TOKEN secret in your repo. Its own node, Tend / Clients / Releases and CI, is proposed (01a10b0c).
